title: Ukrainian drones strike Russian oil refineries at Kstovo and Oryol
body:
On 12 March 2024 Ukrainian drones attacked oil refining facilities in two Russian regions. In Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, a fuel and energy complex at Kstovo, reportedly owned by Lukoil, was hit. Kstovo lies about 828 kilometres from the Ukrainian border. Governor Gleb Nikitin said special services were working to contain a fire at one oil refining installation.

In Oryol Oblast, about 160 kilometres from the border, Governor Andrey Klychkov confirmed that a drone struck a refinery and that a tank containing petroleum products caught fire. At least 17 people were evacuated from high-rise buildings near the site to a temporary accommodation centre. Regional officials reported no casualties from the refinery strikes.

Russia's Ministry of Defence said Ukraine launched at least 25 drones and seven missiles overnight, targeting Moscow, Leningrad, Belgorod, Kursk, Bryansk, Tula and Oryol regions. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said a drone heading toward the capital was shot down over the Ramensky district. Al Jazeera reported that Kyiv had recently concentrated its attacks on Russian refineries and energy facilities.
